cohort: 100 pregnant women requiring induction of labour at a single obstetrics and gynecology department over a two-year period.
finding: Mechanical methods of labor induction with oxytocin augmentation were effective, with varying induction to delivery intervals observed between primigravida and multigravida women.
gest_age: term gestation was the most common indication for induction
birth_weight: The mean weight of neonates was 3.026 kgs.
